reference.title: API v1 reference
reference.description: REST + JSON. Each request is authenticated with an API key, and the data belongs to the key's organization.
reference.conventions: Lists: ?limit= (max 100), offset=, q= (search), updated_since= (ISO 8601). Responses contain data and pagination; errors contain error.code (and error.fields for validation), with status codes 401, 403, 404, 422, 429. PATCH changes only the fields sent; DELETE is a soft delete.
